description: Online and paper deadlines scoped to different methods are NOT a contradiction — emit two separate labeled deadlines, no conflict flag.

input.text:
RIVERSIDE COUNTY FAMILY SERVICES
DATE: 06/10/2027
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
You can renew benefits online or by returning the form that came with this letter.
Due dates:
Send your renewal as soon as you can. Your online renewal is due by 07/15/2027, but the paper form must be returned by 07/01/2027.
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
